event_context_period.meaning: Core intense-rainfall interval cited in 01_flood_event_overview.md; not a complete impact or simulation period.

event_analysis_window.meaning: Initial candidate analysis window proposed during Step 1; distinct from the researcher-selected ERA5-Land runoff acquisition period and from the still-undecided simulation period.

period.meaning: Model execution and spin-up period; not yet decided by Step 12 runoff acquisition.

domain.bbox_convention: WGS84 outer cell-boundary edges in west, south, east, north order; not the centers of corner cells.
domain.selection_note: Integer-aligned outer bounds selected for the simulation window: 3–13°E, 45–53°N. The prior decimal values are retained separately as the earlier corner-cell-center candidate.

simulation.selection_note: Candidate outer window covering the inspected model routing-group cell envelopes and margins. Confirm the full target watershed, group scope, active-cell mask and boundary treatment before use.

search_period.selection_note: Focused three-day search around 2021-07-15, the central disaster date for this survey; the broader 2021-07-13 to 2021-07-20 scan is retained in development history.

domain.basis: Step 2 candidate area using the existing processed GFM target-grid bounds; valid support for the 2021-07-15 pass is incomplete and patchy.

period.rationale: Starts before the flood event to provide a pre-event preparation interval; this alone does not establish adequate model spin-up.

runoff_forcing_acquisition.domain_basis: Requested CDS area extends 0.5 degrees beyond each outer edge of the Step 11 regional map [3.0, 45.0, 13.0, 53.0]. Actual returned grid centers and cell edges are recorded in metadata/12_era5land_runoff.json.
